name: pg_pathcheck
abstract: Validate planner Path trees for freed/garbage memory.
description: pg_pathcheck is a debug aid that walks every Path in a finished query tree and flags freed or alias-recycled nodes via NodeTag and parent-match checks. It is a pure shared-library module loaded via shared_preload_libraries; it registers no SQL objects. This release targets the PostgreSQL master development branch (19devel): it requires planner_shutdown_hook and the PlannerGlobal extension_state slot API, neither of which exists in 18 or earlier. Use the pg17-18 branch for those releases.
